Both male and female unmarried citizens of Pakistan are eligible, and there is no relaxation of the upper age limit.

metaDescription: Join PAF as GD Pilot 2026: age 16-22, FSc 65%+, 5'4" height, 6/6 vision. Register at joinpaf.gov.pk - ISSB + FAT selection, 4-year training.

sections.content:
The Pakistan Air Force inducts General Duty Pilots through a Permanent Commission course advertised roughly twice a year — the 162nd GD(P) course is the 2026 entry most applicants are targeting. Both male and female citizens of Pakistan can apply, and candidates must be unmarried.

On the cutoff date fixed in the advertisement (15 April 2027 for the 162 course), your age must be between 16 and 22 years. Minimum height is 5 feet 4 inches (163 cm), and the vision standard is strict: 6/6 eyesight in each eye without glasses, with color blindness disqualifying.
sections.title: Who Can Apply for GD Pilot

sections.content:
You need a minimum of 65% aggregate marks in any one of these streams: FSc Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical or Computer Science; A-Level with Physics, Mathematics and Computer Science or Biology; FSc with Physics plus any two of Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science and Biology; or a DAE (Diploma of Associate Engineering) in Avionics, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Telecommunication, Automation, Computer Information or Software.

A-Level candidates must obtain an IBCC equivalence certificate. A NADRA Smart Card is mandatory before online registration — keep scanned copies of your CNIC or B-Form, Matric and FSc result cards, domicile and four recent passport photos ready.
sections.title: Education Requirements

sections.content:
Registration is online only at joinpaf.gov.pk during the advertised window (for example, 22 July to 3 August 2026 for the intake advertised in July). There is no application fee. After registration you receive a test date at the nearest PAF Information and Selection Centre.

The selection sequence is: an academic/computer-based initial test, ISSB tests at Kohat, Gujranwala or Malir, a full medical board, and — unique to the pilot branch — the Flying Aptitude Test (FAT). Clearing every stage on merit gets you into the 4-year program.
sections.title: Registration and Selection Process

sections.content:
Selected GD(P) cadets train for four years, earning a BS in Aviation Management, or a BE in Aerospace or Avionics from the College of Aeronautical Engineering. Flying training is conducted at PAF Academy Asghar Khan, Risalpur.

GD Pilots form the core of PAF's fighter, transport and helicopter fleets. Alongside prestige and job security, the branch offers government accommodation, free medical cover for the family and structured promotions up to the highest ranks of the Air Force.
